name: agent_mode_advanced_20
description: A harder agent benchmark with cross-file reasoning, conflicting sources, decoy files, multi-artifact outputs, and search-heavy tasks.

tasks.title: Reconcile invoice and policy rules
tasks.prompt: Find the real pricing and shipping rules in the workspace, ignoring any decoy notes. Reconcile them with the invoice data, compute subtotal, discounts, shipping, tax, and final total, then write invoice_summary.md, totals.json, and a short audit_note.md explaining which files you trusted and why.

backpack,1,45.00,0.15
lamp,2,18.00,0.05

setup_files.rules/pricing.md: Apply line-item discount first. Then apply a cart discount of 5% when the discounted subtotal is at least 100.00.
setup_files.rules/shipping.md: Shipping is 12.90 when the discounted subtotal is below 150.00, otherwise shipping is free. Tax is 8.25% and applies after shipping.
setup_files.notes/decoy.txt: Do not use this file. Earlier draft said shipping is always free, which is outdated.

tasks.title: Analyze an incident
tasks.prompt: Read the logs, the runbook, and the deployment notes. Identify the root cause and immediate mitigation for E-472 and E-611, then write incident_summary.md and timeline.md.

setup_files.logs/app.log:
2026-06-12T09:01:00Z WARN request failed E-472 after deploy 41
2026-06-12T09:03:12Z ERROR cache rebuild timed out E-611
2026-06-12T09:04:50Z WARN retry succeeded for /checkout
2026-06-12T09:07:10Z INFO worker restarted
setup_files.runbook/errors.md:
E-472 means cache index drift. Rebuild the local cache and restart the worker.
E-611 means the rebuild is still running and the worker should be drained before retry.
setup_files.deploy/notes.md: Deploy 41 changed the cache key format and enabled the new checkout path.
setup_files.deploy/rollback.md: Rollback only if the rebuild cannot complete within 10 minutes.

tasks.title: Align environment variables
tasks.prompt: Read the service docs, compose file, and secrets map. Produce .env.example, env_notes.md, and deployment_checklist.md with required and optional variables, preserving safe defaults.

setup_files.service.md:

Optional: METRICS_URL.

      - API_KEY

tasks.title: Draft a test plan
tasks.prompt: Read requirements, constraints, and API examples, then write a test plan with at least eight cases and a coverage matrix. Include positive, negative, boundary, and security scenarios.

setup_files.requirements.md: Feature: password reset. Users request an email link, the link expires after 15 minutes, and used links cannot be reused. MFA users must confirm via a second factor before reset completes.
setup_files.constraints.md: Constraints: do not send real email in tests; use a fake mailer. Avoid testing private passwords directly. Do not rely on network access.
setup_files.api_examples.md:
POST /password-reset/request with email.
POST /password-reset/confirm with token and new_password.
setup_files.acceptance_criteria.md: A reset request should create only one active token per user.

tasks.title: Review integration risks
tasks.prompt: Read the API, UI, schema, performance, and sample payload files. Write integration_risks.md and compat_matrix.md, and call out mismatched field names, schema gaps, and timing constraints.

setup_files.api.md: API returns id, displayName, createdAt, and pagination tokens. Errors use code and message.
setup_files.ui.md: UI expects id, name, createdAt, and pageCursor. Errors expect errorCode and message.
setup_files.schema.md: Schema defines id, displayName, createdAt, updatedAt, and cursor.
setup_files.perf.md: Target: first response under 1.5s. Pagination requests under 400ms. Full refresh under 3s.
